en: Let's play. I'll sit over here.
The stones are ready. Take your time.

zh: 这盘是我赢啦，再来一盘吗？
en: My win! Shall we play again?
You won this one. Well played.

zh: 棋盘都坐满了，平分这一盘吧。
en: The board's full. Let's share this game.

zh: 这次我连起来啦，再来一盘吗？
en: I connected them this time! Another game?

zh: 看到你的五颗了，这一盘下得真好。
en: I see your five. That was a lovely game.

zh: 完整母版（镜像/原木调深仅按标记）
en: Complete master artwork (mirroring and darker timber only where marked)

zh: 蓝屋已有阁楼窗，保留原位置，不额外切开屋顶插新窗。望远镜放院子。
en: The blue house already has a dormer. Keep it in place; do not cut a new roof opening. Telescope stays in the yard.

zh: 花箱实际来自原有花盆组合，保留原盆形；花架放院子，不改屋体。
en: The flower box reuses the original planter cluster and keeps its pot shapes. The trellis belongs in the yard, not on the house.

zh: 原大屋与小屋图像相同；保留原门阶作为门廊落脚台，不虚构带顶门廊。第二烟囱为原件完整裁切。
en: The original large house shares the cottage image. Keep the existing doorstep as a porch landing; do not invent a roofed porch. The second chimney is a complete original crop.

zh: 侧面窄窗移到正面透视不一致，因此保留原窗。仅木梁/门原木色内调深，院子配长椅。
en: Moving the narrow side window to the front would break perspective, so keep it. Darken only within the existing timber colors on beams and doors. Add the bench in the yard.

zh: 保留母版原有宽侧窗；加宽拼接会破坏窗框与透视，因此不硬拼。风铃晾衣绳放院子。
en: Keep the master's wide side window. Widening it would break its frame and perspective. Wind chimes and the clothesline belong in the yard.

zh: 这阵子想和你一起喝碗萝卜汤。
en: I'd like to share a bowl of turnip soup with you sometime.

zh: 要是能一起吃点烤南瓜就好了。
en: It would be lovely to share some roast pumpkin.

zh: 想找一天和你一起吃番茄沙拉。
en: I'd like to share tomato salad with you one day.

zh: 看看奶油色等身豆豆鱼
en: See a cream-colored person-sized bean fish

zh: 想和你一起看看奶油色的小豆豆鱼。
en: I'd like us to see a little cream-colored bean fish together.

zh: 看看薄荷色超大飘带鱼
en: See a giant mint-colored ribbon fish

zh: 好奇薄荷色的大飘带鱼会是什么样。
en: I wonder what a large mint-colored ribbon fish looks like.

zh: 想看到屋里多一张能安心坐着的椅子。
en: I'd like to see one more chair in the cottage, a comfortable place to sit.

zh: 想和你到建好的凉亭里坐一会儿。
en: I'd like to sit with you in a finished pavilion for a while.

zh: 很想看到我们院子里的花圃真正完工。
en: I'd really like to see our courtyard flower garden finished.

zh: 这个小愿望真的实现了，心里暖暖的。
en: This little wish really came true. It feels warm inside.

zh: 原来盼着的这件小事，真的发生了。
en: That small thing I hoped for really happened.

zh: 看到它实现，我开心得想多待一会儿。
en: Seeing it happen makes me want to linger here happily.

zh: 这件小事有了结果，想好好记住。
en: This little hope has an ending. I'd like to remember it.

zh: 先准备食材，再一起吃完这道菜。
en: Prepare the real ingredients, then finish the dish together.

zh: 到当前岛屿海边，让她在场看看新钓获。
en: Visit the current island's shore so she can witness a new catch.

zh: 用真实木材制作，放进已建好的屋里。
en: Craft it with real wood and place it in a completed cottage.

zh: 到建好的设施各找一个空位。
en: Find an empty seat each at a completed facility.

zh: 用真实木材和收获箱作物完成花圃。
en: Complete the garden using real wood and crops from harvest boxes.

zh: 先种下%s，收获后再一起做菜。
en: Plant %s first, then harvest it and cook together.
%s is growing. Remember to harvest when it's ripe.

zh: 嗯……想把今天过得松松软软的。
en: Mm... I'd like today to feel soft and easy.

zh: 小岛上又多了一会儿安静的时间。
en: A little more quiet time on the island.
Island keeper, I'm right beside you.
I'll stay with you for a while.

zh: 不用急着安排事情，歇一会儿也好。
en: No need to plan something right away. A little rest is good too.

zh: 听见斧头的声音了，木头一点点攒起来啦。
en: I hear the axe. We're gathering wood a little at a time.

zh: 你忙你的，我在旁边看看。
en: Keep doing your thing. I'll watch from beside you.

zh: 木材一点点攒着，离小屋又近一点。
en: A little more wood, a little closer to a cottage.

zh: 先让它慢慢烤，我在这里等一会儿。
en: Let it grill slowly. I'll wait here a little.

zh: 烤好了，想吃的时候就过来坐吧。
en: It's ready. Come sit when you'd like some.

zh: 炉边留着座位，可以一起坐一会儿。
en: There's a seat by the fire. We could sit together a while.

zh: 我们的家又有一点轮廓了。
en: Our home is taking a little more shape.

zh: 一根一根木头，慢慢变成家。
en: One piece of wood at a time, becoming a home.

zh: 等这里盖好，再想想摆些什么。
en: When it's finished, we can think about what to put here.

zh: 看到小屋，就有回家的感觉了。
en: Seeing the cottage feels like coming home.

zh: 这间小屋是我们一点点搭起来的。
en: We built this little cottage piece by piece.

zh: 这边的树荫看起来很舒服。
听着叶子的声音，发一会儿呆。
en: Listen to the leaves and daydream a little.
Sit a while and look at the view.

zh: 找个小凳子，安静待一会儿。
en: Find a little stool and sit quietly.
Just the spot for a short rest.
A little closer to you here.
I'll stay here with you a while.

zh: 这面烤好了，可以翻面啦。
en: This side is grilled. Time to turn it.
The mushrooms are waiting to be turned.

zh: 窗边的光刚好，坐一会儿吧。
en: The light by the window is just right. Sit a while?

zh: 这个角落，慢慢有家的样子了。
en: This corner is slowly beginning to feel like home.

zh: 屋里安静下来，也很舒服呢。
en: A quiet room feels lovely too.
This little roadside flower is for you.

zh: 看到这朵花，就想拿来给你。
en: I saw this flower and wanted to bring it to you.
Here. A little color for today.

zh: 还记得一起吃{dish}的那回吗。
上次我吃蘑菇时，你也在桌边。
en: When I ate mushrooms last time, you were at the table too.

zh: 上次一起烧烤、收拾烤架，还记得吗。
en: Remember our barbecue, and tidying the grill afterward?

zh: 还记得我们一起盖好的那座房子吗。
en: Do you remember the house we finished together?

zh: 我上次钓的那条大鱼，个头可真大。
en: That big fish I caught last time was really something.

zh: 还记得我们下过的那盘五子棋吗。
en: Do you remember our game of Gomoku?

zh: 我上次盼着的“{wish}”，后来真的实现了呢。
en: That wish of mine, “{wish}”, really came true later.

zh: 还记得我们在月牙岛一起吃烧烤吗？
en: Remember our barbecue on Moon Island?
It's lovely just to linger for a while.

zh: 这会儿想轻轻松松地待着。
en: I'd like to take things easy just now.
No hurry. Let's take our time.
I'm in a good mood right now.
I'd like to find something easy to do.

zh: 有点开心，想在你附近待着。
en: Feeling a little happy. I'd like to stay near you.

zh: 忙了一阵，闲下来想慢一点。
en: After a busy stretch, I'd like to slow down in my free time.

zh: 手里的事照常做，闲时歇一会儿。
en: Work goes on as usual. I'll rest when I'm free.

zh: 这会儿想安安静静待一下。
en: I'd like a quiet moment right now.
I'd like some quiet. No hurry.
No need to talk right away. I'm here.
Shall we light a fire first?
I'm glad you're here for our first meal.

zh: 记住啦，这是我们的第一顿烧烤！
en: I'll remember this! Our first barbecue!

zh: 以后的小岛，也一点点慢慢建吧。
en: We'll build the rest of the island little by little too.

zh: 围着火坐着，这里已经有点像家了。
en: Sitting around the fire, this already feels a little like home.

zh: 第一次吃面条鱼，细细的真有趣。
en: First time eating noodlefish. So slender... interesting.
First time eating eel. It smells lovely.

zh: 第一次吃风筝鱼，尾巴长长的。
en: First time eating kitefish. What a long tail.

zh: 第一次吃带鱼，银亮亮的鱼真香。
en: First time eating ribbonfish. Silvery and delicious.
